about: Photo filters as film stocks: the Print model with per-filter tone, color and texture. Built by scripts/filmlooks.py; exported with scripts/print-look.py export-swift. Keys left out inherit from Print. grey = display luminance of 18% grey; slope = log-log contrast below the shoulder; shoulder = how hard highlights turn; white/floor = display white and black; printer/crossover = [red, blue] log-exposure offsets / gamma splits; interlayer = saturation; crosstalk = 0..1 of print-dye density coupling; grain = density std at 4032 px.

natural.name: Natural
natural.about: A clean color-negative scan: gentle film curve, open highlights, true color.

warm400.name: Warm 400
warm400.about: Portrait color negative: golden, low contrast, pastel color and flattering skin.
